results.detail:
I re-derived every unit from the raw DTSX, and all units except one wording in [5] are correct.
[1] The source 'Get Agent Or Agency Detail From Fund' uses connection [CRM] (DTSX:2088), with the SqlCommand at DTSX:1970. In both active branches the WHERE is ((Gen_existinfile not null and = 1) OR (gen_revaluationdate not null and year(...) >= year(getdate())-3)) AND poa.gen_currentstate = 1 (DTSX:2049-2053, 2073-2077). That is a lower bound only, evaluated on the DB server clock. The existinfile meaning is labelled השערה. The ownership argument is the ambiguity rule plus 0034 DTSX:15 ('from Gen_fundmain where gen_existinfile = 1', a single-table FROM). Branch 1 uses LEFT JOINs gen_agents.gen_contactname = poa.gen_agentname and gen_agencie.gen_agencyname = poa.gen_agencyname, and outputs the record IDs gen_agentsid / gen_agencieid (DTSX:2038-2039, 2046-2047). The contact/account reading is supported by 0029 DTSX:26979 'Account.AccountId = Gen_agencie.gen_agencyname'. Branch 2 uses ac1 on fund.gen_brokernumber and ac2 on ac1.gen_agencycontractnumber; agent and agency are LEFT JOINed by PK from ac2. It requires (poa agent = fund agent OR poa agency = fund agency) and ac1.Gen_isContractDataSharing = 1 (DTSX:2055-2082). 'Parent contract' matches the SQL comment at DTSX:2055. The ROW_NUMBER partition is FUND_NUMBER (= gen_fundmain.gen_fundnumber), CONTACT, ACCOUNT, AGENT, AGENCY, ordered by POW_START_DATE desc over the UNION ALL, with RowNum = 1 (DTSX:1973, 2034, 2054, 2084). The NULL-partition, NULL-sorts-last and tie statements are correct.
[2] The Lookup is full cache, NoMatchBehavior 1, on [CRM], 'select * from [dbo].[Gen_allowedinformationforfundBase]'. It joins AGENT_NAME->Gen_agentname, AGENCY_NAME->Gen_agencyname, CONTACT_NAME->Gen_contactname, ACCOUNT_NAME->Gen_accountname and FUND_GUID->Gen_fundname. Only the No Match path continues. 'filtering customers dead' is full cache, CONTACT_NAME->ContactId from 'select ContactId from Contact where gen_customeragename = N'נפטר''; only No Match continues to Create system columns (DTSX:1906-1922, 2137-2216 paths). [3] matches this.
[4] The OLE DB Destination uses AccessMode 0, OpenRowset [dbo].[Gen_allowedinformationforfundBase] and [CRM] (DTSX:608-616). It has exactly 16 mapped columns, all listed with the right sources (AGENCY_NAME->Gen_agencyname, AGENT_NAME->Gen_agentname, AllowedfundinfoID->Gen_allowedinformationforfundId, ACCOUNT_NAME->Gen_accountname, CONTACT_NAME->Gen_contactname, FUND_GUID->Gen_fundname, POW_MAIN->Gen_powerofattorneymainname, CreatedBy, CreatedOn, ModifiedBy, ModifiedOn, OwningBusinessUnit, StateCode->statecode, StatusCode->statuscode, OwningUser->OwnerId, IS_COMMISSION_AGENT->gen_agentreceivescommissionnly). The main.vb (DTSX:686) lines are exact: 18 BusinessUnitId, 19-21 SystemUserId, 25/33 UtcNow, 27 StatusCode = 1, 29 DeletionStateCode = 0 (unmapped), 30 StateCode = 0, 36 Guid.NewGuid. Step 3 = 'Get systemuser organisationname and curency' in the precedence chain. 'Get System user id' looks up SystemUser.DomainName = derived @[User::UserName] (DTSX:5390-5414, 7314). 'Set system variables' sets BusinessUnitId and SystemUserId (DTSX:6503-6512). The design-time connection plus config-override caveat is present (DTSX:6, 17).
[5] WRONG on one wording. It twice calls the POA 'ייפוי כוח נוכחי' ('לקוחות שנתנו להם ייפוי כוח נוכחי', 'ללקוח יש ייפוי כוח נוכחי'), as fact and without a hedge. The only proven condition is gen_powerofattorney.gen_currentstate = 1, which [1] itself states literally. No supplied file defines value 1 for gen_powerofattorney. The code constants ACTIVE = 1 / CURRENT_STATE_ACTIVE = 1 / '//active' in 0029 (DTSX:22710, 22760, 33990, 38017, 38077-38082) apply to gen_powerofattorneymain, a different entity. 'Active POA' (0029) and 'Get Active Poa' / 'ActivePoas' (0030 DTSX:4187, 4222) are data-flow, component and alias names, and under the standard names are not proof. The package's own open-question text records this: 'בחבילה זו משמעות הערך gen_powerofattorney.gen_currentstate = 1 אינה מוגדרת'. [1] in this same claim labels the analogous Gen_existinfile meaning השערה. So 'נוכחי' is an unproven meaning stated as fact, and it is inconsistent with that open-question statement.
Not counted: the Lookup NULL-key matching behaviour in full-cache mode is not shown in the files, and the text makes no claim about it. FastLoadKeepNulls = false (DTSX:612) means unmapped or NULL columns take table defaults if any exist; the schema is external and the text does not claim otherwise.

wrongUnits.unit: [5] 'לקוחות שנתנו להם ייפוי כוח נוכחי' / 'ללקוח יש ייפוי כוח נוכחי'
wrongUnits.problem: This states the meaning of gen_powerofattorney.gen_currentstate = 1 ('current') as fact. No supplied file defines that value for gen_powerofattorney. The ACTIVE = 1 constants in 0029 are for gen_powerofattorneymain, and the 0029/0030 'Active POA' / 'ActivePoas' evidence consists of names only. The package's open-question text says the meaning is not defined.
wrongUnits.correct: Use the literal condition, e.g. 'ייפוי כוח עם gen_currentstate = 1', or label it: 'ייפוי כוח במצב 1 (המשמעות "נוכחי/פעיל" – השערה; בחבילה 0030 ערך זה מסונן ברכיב Get Active Poa)'.
